dialogue.Introduction: Oh! A new face in my lab. Hello, @! I am the Steampunker, and this valley is about to get a whole lot more clockwork.$h#$b#Mind the springs on the floor, they bite. And never trust a gear that has not been greased.$u
dialogue.Mon: Morning, @! I stayed up half the night rewiring the water pump. It hums in a perfectly lovely key now.$h
dialogue.Tue: Tuesdays are quiet around here. The Mechanic is out fixing fences, so the lab is all mine. Gears turning, kettle whistling. Bliss.
dialogue.Wed: Have you seen the goggles I built? They fog up in the mines, but they make the dark look so much friendlier.$h
dialogue.Thu: The Truffle wandered in this morning and asked whether mushrooms have gears. I said no. I am considering a study, though.$u
dialogue.Fri: Fridays are scrap day. Every pile of junk in town passes through here eventually, and somewhere in it there is always a treasure.$h
dialogue.Sat: Saturday is market day in Pelican Town, and I always end up buying half the stalls' broken clocks. Do not judge me.$l
dialogue.Sun: Sundays the lab goes silent and I just listen to the gears tick. There is nothing cozier in the world.$h
dialogue.Mon2: @, could you hand me that spanner? Thank you. You have good hands for a farmer. Steady and patient.
dialogue.Tue2: Oh, you came to visit again. I was just about to sweep up a pile of brass shavings. Care to help?$h
dialogue.Thu2: The Truffle is hiding in the basement again. I think it is shy, but it keeps asking me to build a tiny bell for its mushroom room.
dialogue.Mon4: @, you have become a real friend of the lab, so you get to see the good stuff. Look here. A brass escapement I have been working on for six days.$h#$b#It keeps better time than the clock in the town hall. Please do not tell the Mayor.$h
dialogue.Tue4: Sometimes I dream in blueprints. Last night I dreamed of a steam carriage that could climb the mountain without stopping for breath. I woke up sketching it.$h
dialogue.Wed4: I used to tinker in the dark, back in the caves, with nobody to watch. It is nice having somebody stop by to see what I am up to.$h
dialogue.Thu4: The Mechanic and I argue about everything. Gears versus wires, steam versus sparks. But she is brilliant, and I will not say that to her face.$l
dialogue.Fri4: If I find a piece of old Terraria machinery in the scrap pile, I cannot help myself. I just have to take it apart to see how it ticks.$h
dialogue.Sat4: I am not from around here, you know. Eager to learn, bad at small talk. Thank you for putting up with my enthusiasm, @.$h
dialogue.Sun4: Let me show you something special. This brass orrery shows the moons, the seasons, even the tides in the bay. I built it to remember home.$s
dialogue.Mon8: @, you are the first person who ever asked me how the workings of my heart run. I do not know what to say. Only that I am glad you asked.$l
dialogue.Tue8: Sometimes I wonder if the valley really has room for someone like me. All sparks and steam, and I scare the chickens. You make me feel like I belong.$s
dialogue.Wed8: I keep a little brass box with the first gear I ever made. It is wobbly and crooked, and I love it more than anything. I wanted you to know that.$l
dialogue.Thu8: When the goblins came, I hid in the lab with a wrench and my goggles on. I was so scared. You went out and fought them, and I just kept building, because it was all I could do.$s
dialogue.Fri8: We can share the lab if you ever need a warm place to sit, @. I have a chair nobody has ever sat in. It is comfortable, I promise.$h
dialogue.Sat8: Let us go out to the beach some evening and watch the sun set over the bay. I want to tell you about the star I wanted to build. Maybe you can help me finish it.$l
dialogue.Sun8: Thank you for every Sunday you have stopped in. I was lonely with only gears for company. Now I have a friend who asks good questions.$h
dialogue.Fri2: Did you bring any scrap today, @? Anything shiny, or anything that once had a motor. I am a good home for broken things.$h
dialogue.Wed2: Oh, good, you are here. I was just about to ask whether you know how to solder. Hold this wire steady for me, please.
dialogue.Sat2: Saturday already? The week goes by in a blur of clicks and whirs. Do you ever feel like the days wind up faster than you do?
dialogue.Sun2: Quiet Sunday, @. I have been reading old Terraria machine manuals in the lab. Some of the diagrams are beautifully strange.$h
dialogue.Mon6: I finally fixed the hiss in the boiler. It only took three nights and a very unhappy kettle. Would you like to hear it sing now?$h
dialogue.Wed6: There is a little gear inside my heart, I think. Some days it turns smoothly. Some days it grinds. Today it is turning very nicely, thanks to you.$l
dialogue.Fri6: Scrap day is my favorite, and not just because of the treasure. You always come by with a grin and a question. It makes the junk feel less lonely.$h
dialogue.Sun6: I think I want to plant a little garden in the yard, between the gears and the pipes. Something green to balance all the brass. Would you help me pick the seeds?$h
dialogue.summer_Wed: Summer heat makes my steam engine cough. Still, the sunshine through the lab window is lovely on the brass.
dialogue.spring_Tue: Spring rain drips down the lab roof and I hear new gears tuning themselves in my head. I think they are whispering about flowers.
dialogue.fall_Sat: The leaves turn orange and the wind rattles the pipes. Fall is the season I build the most. Everything wants to be oiled and warm.$h
dialogue.winter_Fri8: Snow piles up against the lab door, but my furnace roars and the goggles stay warm. Winter is the perfect time to hide indoors with a friend and a good project.$l
dialogue.spring_1: First day of spring! I celebrated by rewinding every clock in the lab. Now they are all singing a little off key.
dialogue.summer_12: The summer sun is generous today. I have been out cutting brass sheets in the yard, and I am feeling all sparks and sunshine.$h
dialogue.fall_15: Halfway through autumn and the lab is full of pumpkin scraps and copper dust. I love this time of year. Everything smells like cider and oil.$h
dialogue.winter_7: Cold morning, @. My breath steams in the lab and my goggles frost over. Good thing I built a heater that is not a scandal to look at.$h

rainy: Rain on the lab roof sounds like a drumroll for my little automaton. Pour all you like, I am warm, dry, and perfectly oiled.$h

situations.eye: The Eye of Cthulhu is finally gone. I spent last night polishing my telescope lenses, just in case it came back for an encore.$h
situations.evilBoss: The worm and the brain are both defeated. Those things were wretched, but the scraps they left behind are going to make some fine springs.$h
situations.skeletron: Skeletron is down, and the dungeon is open. The Old Man is free. I always wanted to see the dungeon machinery up close. Oh, I have so many plans now.$u
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee is gone. Her honeycomb wax is the most wonderful sticky stuff for sealing pipes. Thank you, @, you are a brave soul.$h
situations.hardmode: The Wall of Flesh fell and hardmode has begun. The Hallow is spreading, and the new machines out there are stronger than ever. Be careful out there, please.$s
situations.mechs: One of the mechanical bosses has been destroyed. I felt the thrum of its gears stop from all the way in the lab. Such a clean victory.$h
situations.plantera: Plantera has been defeated, and the jungle temple is open at last. I have been dying to see the mechanisms in there. Pack a lantern, @!$u
situations.golem: The Golem is finally in pieces. I mean, I am very sorry for the temple guardian, but his stone gears are beautiful. I will have them polished by noon.$h
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist is defeated, and the celestial pillars have appeared. The sky is humming with power. I could feel it through my goggles all night.$u
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord is gone. The whole sky went quiet at last. I have never been so relieved in my life. Maybe now I can sleep.$s
situations.goblins: The goblin army was repelled last night. Those little fellows tried to steal my screws. I put out a sign, and they ran off with their tails between their legs.$h
situations.pirates: The pirates were chased off last night. One of them tried to pawn me a cursed cannon. I told him I already have too many cannons, thank you.$a
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion was driven back. My poor furnace nearly went out, but the lab held. Stay warm, @, and remember to keep your boots dry.$h
situations.martians: The Martians came down in their saucers and the lasers filled the sky. I counted every single gear in those ships. Such marvelous engineering, even when it is shooting at us.$u
situations.bloodMoon: There was a blood moon last night. Every gear in the lab was ticking like it was afraid. I barred the shutters and stayed in with a cup of tea.$s
situations.eclipse: The sun went dark for a while yesterday. I saw the eclipse through a sheet of smoked glass. It is a shame not everyone in town looked up to see it.$h
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today. Yes, I have been invited, and no, I have not decided whether to wear my goggles. Bring some sparkly gears if you go.$h

festivals.spring13: The Egg Festival! I hid a clockwork egg in the bushes, and it ticks when you find it. Please go find it, it is very proud of its ticking.$h
festivals.spring24: The Flower Dance is tonight. I have fitted my dress with tiny brass gears so it chimes when I twirl. If you ask me to dance, I might fall over laughing.$h
festivals.summer11: The Luau! Everyone adds something to the community soup. I brought a gadget that stirs the pot by itself. It is not as safe as it looks, so stand back, @.$u
festivals.summer28: Dance of the Moonlight Jellies. The beach is lit with glowing jellies, and my goggles make them look like tiny stars. Come walk the shore with me.$h
festivals.fall16: The Stardew Valley Fair! I entered my brass orrery in the grange display. Win or lose, the judges will be dazzled by the gears, I am sure of it.$h
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve. The haunted maze has clockwork ghosts this year, and I built half of them. Do not let the mechanical skeleton catch you, I promise it is only a little bit scary.$u
festivals.winter8: The Festival of Ice! I am entering the snow sculpture contest with a steam-powered owl. It flaps its wings and puffs a little cloud. Please come see it, @.$h
festivals.winter25: The Feast of the Winter Star. I drew your name for the gift exchange, and I have built you something special. Open it carefully, the spring inside is quite happy.$h

loved.text: Oh! A gift for the lab? You truly understand me. Look, a perfect little gear in its box. This will keep my heart ticking for a week.$h

liked.text: This is a fine bit of metal. It will go nicely in the next project. Thank you, @.$h

neutral.text: Hm. Interesting. I will find a use for it somewhere in the lab. Thanks, @.

disliked.text: Oh... this is rather a bit of junk, is it not? I suppose I can recycle it into something useful eventually.$a

hated.text: Ugh. Honestly, @, what am I supposed to do with this? Take it back to the swamp where it came from, please.$a

help: Bit of help here? This one bites back!
Little help, please. My springs are jammed!
Cover me, I am reloading the goggles!
thanks: Oh, @, you saved my hide out there. Thank you. My gears are still rattling.$h
That was close, @. Next time I bring a bigger wrench and you get half of it.$u
battle: Hold still, you rusty heap, I am coming!
Full steam ahead! Eat brass, beastie!
For the lab! Nobody scraps my town!
Tick, tick, BOOM. Come and get some!
courage.hurt: Ugh. My goggles are cracked and my springs are all over the floor. I am resting at home today, @. Do not make me build anything.$s

danger.boss: A Terraria boss is loose and my lab is shaking! I have my goggles polished and a wrench ready. Stay close, @!$u
danger.invasion: The invaders are at our gates. I have loaded the brass cannons, and nobody is stealing my screws today.$h
danger.pumpkinMoon: The Pumpkin Moon is rising and the scarecrows have started walking. I have oiled every joint for it.$h
danger.frostMoon: The Frost Moon is out and the cold is creeping into the pipes. My furnace is roaring. Keep your boots dry, @.$h
danger.eclipse: The sky has gone dark and things are crawling out of it. My goggles are on and I am ready to fight. Stay with me, @.$h
danger.bloodMoon: The blood moon is up and the streets are full of things that hunger. I barred the lab door and I am going out anyway.$u

events.after: Careful with that lantern, it is still warm from the furnace. And keep the spare cogs out of the Mechanic's sight, she will try to borrow them.

steps.say: Oh! @, you almost made me drop my spring. Come in, come in. Mind the cogs on the floor.$u
Look at this. A lantern that runs on a little clockwork heart. Ninety seconds of winding and it glows all night.#$b#Practical and pretty. That is the Steampunker's motto.$h

answers.reply: Of course it works. Everything I build works, eventually.$h

answers.text: Looks like a pile of gears.
answers.reply: A pile of gears with a purpose, thank you very much.$a

steps.say: Here, take a few spare cogs. I have a drawer full. Every adventurer needs gears in their pocket.$h

events.after: Did you see the lamp-post on the corner? I fixed it while you were gone. Don't tell the Mayor I used his good copper.

steps.say: @! Perfect timing. I was just testing this pocket watch on the town square bench.$h
It ticks in time with the bells from the church. Listen. Tick, tick, ding. It is such a cheerful sound.$h

I was a terrible show-off as a girl, you know. I climbed the scaffolding of the old clock tower just to see the gears up close.#$b#Nearly got myself killed. Nearly got my mother to lock me in the lab forever.$u

answers.text: Sounds like a bit of trouble.
answers.reply: Oh, plenty. But it was worth every scrape.$h

answers.text: You should have been more careful.
answers.reply: Yes, yes, so everyone tells me. Careful is boring.$s

steps.say: Anyway, you should come by the lab more. I will show you the rest of the clock tower gears. Safely this time, I promise.$h

events.after: The Mechanic says I am not allowed to build a rocket in the carpenter's shop. Please talk her out of letting me.

steps.say: Oh, @, the Mechanic is here too. We were just looking over the new mine cart rails.$h
The rails are straight, the cart is sound, and the wheels are perfectly round. Mostly.$h
Mostly. You see what I live with, @. She is a genius and a menace at the same time.$l
Living under the same roof as the Mechanic and the Truffle is loud and messy. But I would not trade it. They are the closest thing I have to family.#$b#Do not tell them I said so.$l

steps.question: Do you want to visit the Mountain more often?

answers.text: Only if you show me the rails.
answers.reply: Deal! I will even let you ring the bell on the cart.$h

answers.text: No, the Mountain is too windy.
answers.reply: Windy? Hah. Wait until you feel a gust of the Mechanic's wind chimes.$a

steps.say: I am glad you came up here, @. Nobody ever stops by to see my rails.$h

events.after: Thank you for listening, @. I feel lighter tonight. Maybe tomorrow I will tell you about the star I want to build.

steps.say: Oh, you came by late. The lab is so quiet at night, just the furnace and me.$s
I have been wanting to tell you something for weeks, @. Back when I first came to the valley, I thought I would be sent away for being strange.$s
The Mechanic taught me that gears are only useful when they mesh with other gears. Hm. I did not understand it at first.$h

steps.question: Do you think you belong here?

answers.reply: Thank you. I think I believe you. That means more than you know.$l
Harder? I already did. I built a whole lab out of stubbornness.$s

steps.say: This is my goggles. The first pair I built, from the bones of a broken lantern. Take them. They are yours now.$l
Goodnight, @. Mind the springs on the way out.$h

events.after: The Truffle and I are building a tide engine. Please keep the sea gulls from perching on it, they keep stealing the screws.

steps.say: @! The sun is bright on the bay today. The Truffle and I were just testing the new tide engine.$h
It is still a little wobbly. But look at it, @, the water pushes the paddles and the gears turn.$h
I have never been so proud of anything, not even my first brass clock. Thank you for coming down to see it.$l
Hm? You want to know my favorite part of the project? Ha. It is the part where the two of you show up, I think.$h

steps.question: Will you let me help build the next one?

answers.reply: Good, I would not know where to start without you.$h

answers.text: Only if you pay me in mushrooms.
answers.reply: Ha! The Truffle will be thrilled. Mushrooms for everyone.$h

steps.say: Here, I wanted to give you this. A watch that ticks for every friend you have made. Mine ticks loudly these days.$l
Come sit with me on the sand, @. I want to watch the waves with you.$l
